parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment contains two distinct points. The first part suggests showing the original ECG report with punctuation and making the ECG larger for readability. However, the comment does not name any figure, table, or section containing the ECG, so the grounding of this part is unclear and further information would be needed to locate it. The second part asks why RTLP benefits from fine-tuning on multiple languages while MARGE does not, but the comment does not indicate whether this concerns the methodology, the results, or any particular section, so it also lacks an explicit reference to a part of the paper. At the same time, both points do describe in some detail what needs to be addressed: the first requests punctuated original ECG reports and larger ECG displays, and the second asks for an explanation of the RTLP vs. MARGE difference. Thus, the strengths and weaknesses of the comment differ across the two rubric dimensions: it is comparatively stronger in specifying the requested change than in grounding the reference to a specific part of the paper.
